shared_elements: animal or bird figure rendered in profile
low-relief carving on a flat slab surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carvings including a profile creature (a quadruped/reptile in A, a bird within an oval cartouche-like frame in B) and repeated angular chevron-like marks, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a single large isolated animal filling the field with no framing or ordering, whereas B shows small script-like signs organised into vertical columns flanking an oval enclosure containing a bird and other signs — an entirely different compositional logic.
